verdict.rationale: kitty is a terminal emulator, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair thing to ask of it. The pack never mentions MCP or any first-party MCP server. Its remote-control protocol (`kitten @` commands, verified hands-on) is a building block an agent could use, not an official MCP server, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
